summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing routine daily ASX reports tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new authorization, price, or transaction terms were announced; the exhibits simply reproduce disclosures already furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange, mapped to the US equivalent of ongoing buyback transparency reporting. The filing reaffirms intent to repurchase opportunistically subject to market conditions. No advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch only for future ASX disclosures indicating actual buyback pace, which may signal management's valuation view rather than a discrete special situation.
